I just celebrated my 40th birthday and realized that roughly half of my life is already spent. That though does send shiver down my spine.
</message>
output: I keep replaying the party in my head, the cake, the cheers, and it feels like a snapshot from a life that’s already halfway done. The thought of so much time already gone makes me wonder if I’ve been living the way I actually want to, or just going through the motions.
